nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_ledger.py

nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for the regime classifier covering all signal-regime labels, boundary conditions, serialization, config loading and injection, provenance propagation, and rule-table invariants.

nodes.summary: Verifies that the trace version field in a classification result is independent of the decision label across two different feature vectors.

nodes.summary: Tests for the GuardrailEngine covering approval, predicate-named blocking, malformed requests, short-circuit behavior, determinism, environment-config loading, and decision invariants.

nodes.summary: Verifies that load_config_from_env correctly reads all expected GuardrailConfig values from environment variable overrides.

nodes.name: test_consumer.py

nodes.name: test_models.py

nodes.summary: Validates that all numeric fields in the snapshot series values are parsed with full floating-point fidelity from the real fixture.

nodes.name: test_guards_parsed
nodes.summary: Asserts that guardrail fields in the snapshot are parsed correctly, including status flags and threshold values from the real fixture.

nodes.summary: Unit tests for supervisor scoring functions (weakness_severity, score_option) verifying calibration weakness, binary PnL weakness, zero for unknown dimensions, cost-efficiency weighting, and nonpositive cost rejection.

nodes.summary: Wiki article on context window budget management covering budget categories, optimization strategies (selective reading, memory windowing, context resets, prompt engineering, tiered file architecture), and context window sizes across models.

nodes.name: Graph Health Dashboard.md
